"""RoboWits limited-mode cube retrieval control script and saved episode helpers."""
from __future__ import annotations
import sys, json, time, pathlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
RUNS = OUT / 'runs'
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))

seq = 0
def save_result(res, tag):
    global seq
    seq += 1
    dest = RUNS / f'{seq:03d}_{tag}'
    res.save(str(dest))
    print('saved', dest, 'done=', res.meta.get('done'), 'reason=', res.meta.get('reason'), 'plan=', res.meta.get('plan'))
    return res

def observe(tag='observe', depth=True, cameras=None):
    res = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video='none', cameras=cameras)
    save_result(res, tag)
    return res

def q_now(res):
    return np.asarray(res.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)

def tcp_now(res):
    return q_now(res)[16:30]

def pose_row(res, side, xyz=None, quat=None, grip=None):
    tcp = tcp_now(res)
    offs = 0 if side == 'right' else 7
    p = tcp[offs:offs+7].copy()
    if xyz is not None: p[:3] = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
    if quat is not None: p[3:7] = np.asarray(quat, dtype=float)
    if grip is not None: p = np.r_[p[:7], float(grip)]
    else: p = np.r_[p[:7], float(q_now(res)[7 if side == 'right' else 15])]
    allp = np.r_[tcp[:7], float(q_now(res)[7]), tcp[7:14], float(q_now(res)[15])]
    start = 0 if side == 'right' else 8
    allp[start:start+8] = p
    return allp

def move_ee(res, side, xyz, quat, grip, tag, cameras=None):
    action = pose_row(res, side, xyz, quat, grip)
    print('ee target', side, action)
    result = r.submit('ee_pose', action, video='mp4', cameras=cameras or ['ego', 'wrist_'+side], note=tag)
    return save_result(result, tag)

def ik_target(res, side, xyz, quat):
    q = q_now(res)
    seed = np.r_[q[:7], q[8:15]]
    frame = 'Gripper_Tip_R' if side == 'right' else 'Gripper_Tip_L'
    ans = r.ik({frame: [*map(float, xyz), *map(float, quat)]}, seed=seed)
    print('IK', side, ans)
    return ans

print('connected', spec.get('protocol'), 'budget', spec.get('budget'))
latest = observe('connect', depth=True)
